day:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the FIRST reference image into a polished art-direction frame for the same Gina children's room, retaining its exact identity and composition while translating it into sophisticated hand-painted 3D game art. The other images are STRICT identity references for the girl, cat and tooth trophy. This is one landscape 16:10 room image, not a contact sheet, not a device mockup.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: We are INSIDE this full-bleed room at the child's eye level, looking slightly downward. Floor and walls continue beyond image edges. NO floating dollhouse platform, NO room cutaway, NO exterior empty margins. Retain left large wooden TASK BOARD (about 39% width) with cream header region, a wooden horizontal divider, two generously sized torn-paper tasks, colorful pins, empty teal progress bar and a small hanging teal action tag. Leave paper areas blank and usable for later native UI. Preserve central tall window with teal fabric curtains, warm daylight and visible leafy outdoor scene; middle-right real bookshelf with books, teal backpack and cat photo, hanging trailing ivy with delicate heart-shaped leaves. Foreground teal woven round rug occupies substantial floor area. The same girl sits cross-legged holding an open teal book; the SAME white and chestnut curled sleeping cat rests to her LEFT. Yellow fabric beanbag with teal pillow behind girl. Right upper cream-gold cinema ticket with embossed ticket edge, dimensional popcorn and clapperboard details, empty progress track; hanging seven-cell blank week calendar below; single handsome wooden cabinet below with three meaningful awards: gold-rim tooth trophy, gold-rim green sprout, three-book stack. Drawer and short furniture feet remain integrated with cabinet. Edge-cropped left foreground pencil cup/books and small coral checked bed corner. No new furniture, no extra animals.
CHARACTER IDENTITY: Exact girl from the supplied illustrated reference: soft rounded face, simple dark expressive oval eyes, side-swept chestnut shoulder-length bob with asymmetric overlapping locks and flared hair ends; NOT a smooth helmet or rubber cap. Correct neck and shoulder anatomy, elbows, shaped hands and fingers naturally supporting an open book, crossed legs, simple white socks. Warm coral knit sweatshirt with a single white daisy and gold center. Teal trousers with controlled natural folds. Warm friendly 7–9 year old child proportions, not a baby, not a bobblehead or collectible figurine. Preserve the original quiet smile.
CAT: faithfully preserve the curled silhouette and exact chestnut patches of the reference, compact curled torso rather than a long sausage, tucked paws close to face, natural ears and muzzle, closed sleepy eyes, short soft fur and tapered wrapped tail. Full contact with rug.
QUALITY: Art-directed, high-end family adventure game art with an authored hand-painted finish. Rich local colors and elegant silhouettes, carefully sculpted forms, painterly texture at large-scale, softly rounded hardwood joinery and real grain, subtle knit weave and seams, separated hair locks, rug fibers, paper edge thickness and satin golden awards. Soft global illumination, coherent light direction, subtle contact shadows. Match the inviting reference's teal/coral/cream/honey wood/sunflower-gold palette and vitality. No brown/gray muddy wash, no universal clay material, no stacked spheres/capsules, no toy plastic, no primitive blockout. Room should feel warm and inhabited without visual clutter. All elements share one perspective, light and scale.
TEXT: Remove ALL existing words, logos, letters, numerals, labels and checkmarks from the original. Absolutely no text anywhere, including book spines, plates and calendar. Empty native text surfaces remain deliberately blank. No watermark. Not photorealistic humans. No HTML panels. Keep all requested objects and established room layout.
dayRefinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this Gina room art-direction image. Preserve ALL indoor objects, character identity, cat, hair, expressions, clothing, bookshelf, board, ticket, calendar, cabinet, award forms, layout, framing and indoor palette exactly. The composition is now correct. Change ONLY the OUTDOOR WEATHER treatment visible THROUGH the window: replace the flat decorative sun icon and its drawn rays with a believable softly glowing sun in a pale blue atmospheric sky, delicate light haze, nuanced distant city/tree depth, physically plausible soft sunlight through the window. No symbolic sun pictogram in the sky. Retain the small drawn sun decoration printed on the TASK BOARD; that is not the sky. This is polished hand-painted 3D game art, not a photograph. Preserve restrained indoor soft global illumination and subtle contact shadows; do not wash the coral/teal colors with orange. No letters, words, numbers, logo or watermark. No other changes.

atmosphere.sunset: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the provided Gina room image ONLY for believable sunset atmosphere. STRICTLY preserve the entire composition and geometry, character identity, hair shapes and pose, cat shape/patches/pose, all props, UI surfaces, object positions, proportions, camera, resolution and art style. It is the SAME room, same moment, different illumination. Outside the window a low partly occluded sun near the distant tree line; warm apricot horizon transitioning through soft lavender to blue above, thin lit clouds, layered hazy distant city. No drawn sun symbol or radial pictogram. Inside: a gentle low amber sun beam through the window creating longer coherent soft shadows, a fine warm rim on the hair and cat; indirect neutral cream fill keeps the teal/coral colors readable, papers light cream, gold trophies gold. Keep richly authored hand-painted 3D game style, no photoreal people, no all-orange overlay, no excessive bloom, no dark vignette. Don't invent lamps, stars, furniture or props. Keep absolutely all surfaces text-free: no words, numbers, logos, watermark. Do not change drawn decorations on the board. Keep all paper content regions blank.
atmosphere.nightSnow: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the provided Gina room image ONLY for a believable cozy winter NIGHT with gentle SNOW OUTSIDE THE WINDOW. STRICTLY preserve every indoor object's geometry and location, girl's exact identity/hair/coral daisy sweatshirt/book/pose, the curled white-chestnut cat, boards, ticket, calendar, library, cabinet, camera, aspect and the hand-painted 3D game art style. No model redesign. Outdoor window: deep blue night sky, a soft moon partly veiled by thin cloud, subtle depth-separated falling snowflakes, modest snow resting on exterior tree branches and EXTERIOR sill, softly lit distant windows. Snow must be outside behind the glass, never floating inside the room or over UI. Interior illumination: muted cool blue rim from window balanced by plausible warm indirect room light from off-camera, no invented lamp or new object. Warm wood, coral sweater, teal rug remain distinct and readable; cream paper regions remain luminous enough for future native text. A quiet inviting nighttime mood, not dark horror, no neon blue wash, no yellow-orange filter. Soft cohesive contact shadows and material response. No letters, numbers, text, logos or watermarks anywhere. No drawn snowflake icon or weather pictogram. Preserve all composition and blank native text surfaces.
